title: MIDI Captain Config
description: Configuration for Paint Audio MIDI Captain MAX custom firmware. This schema is the single source of truth for the config format — TypeScript types are generated from it, Rust structs are validated against it, and Python firmware uses it as reference. Note: the title field drives the generated TypeScript interface name, so keep it short and stable.

device.description: Device model. Determines button count and feature availability (encoder/expression are STD10-only).

global_channel.description: Default MIDI channel for all components. Stored as 0-15, displayed as 1-16 in UI.

usb_drive_name.description: USB drive volume label. FAT32 compatible: uppercase alphanumeric + underscore, max 11 chars.

dev_mode.description: When true, USB drive mounts on every boot. When false (default), requires holding Switch 1 during boot.

pages.description: Ordered list of pages (banks). Each page is a full control-surface snapshot (buttons + optional encoder/expression). The device renders one page at a time; switch the active page on-device or via the editor. Must contain 1-20 pages — the lower bound and the RAM-validated cap of 20 are enforced by the firmware/editor validators (not as schema minItems/maxItems, which would generate an unwieldy tuple type).

active_page.description: Index of the page rendered at boot (0-based). Clamped to a valid index at load time; out-of-range values do not crash the device.

long_press_threshold_ms.description: Global default long-press threshold in milliseconds for keytimes-mode buttons. Per-button overrides allowed via the button's long_press_threshold_ms field.

midi_thru_usb_to_din.description: MIDI Thru: forward messages received on USB MIDI to the 5-pin DIN output (cross-thru). Default true.

midi_thru_din_to_usb.description: MIDI Thru: forward messages received on the 5-pin DIN MIDI input to the USB MIDI output (cross-thru). Default true.

midi_thru_din_to_din.description: MIDI Thru: forward messages received on the 5-pin DIN input to the 5-pin DIN output (classic MIDI THRU pass-through, for daisy-chaining controllers downstream). Default true.

midi_thru_usb_to_usb.description: MIDI Thru: echo messages received on USB MIDI back to the USB output (host loopback). Default false; enabling can cause duplicate notes or feedback when the DAW has MIDI echo enabled.

page_control.description: Device-level: let an inbound MIDI Control Change switch the active page (jump/inc/dec). Absent or enabled=false means no inbound CC affects pages.

Page.description: One page (bank): a full control-surface snapshot. The device renders one page at a time.

name.description: Optional human-readable page label for the editor and config file. Not shown on the device LCD; not used by firmware routing.

buttons.description: Button configurations for this page. Array length must match device type: std10=10, mini6=6, nano4=4, duo2=2, one1=1.

encoder.description: Per-page rotary encoder configuration. Only supported on STD10.

expression.description: Per-page expression pedal configurations. Only supported on STD10.

global_channel.description: Optional per-page override of the device-wide default MIDI channel. Resolution (button > page > device) lands in a later phase; carried but inert for now.

display.description: Optional per-page override of the device-wide display settings. Resolution lands in a later phase; carried but inert for now.

ButtonMode.description: Button behavior. 'toggle' = latching, 'momentary' = LED on while held, 'flash' = brief LED flash (PC types), 'select' = radio-group exclusivity, 'keytimes' = multi-state cycle with short/long press timing (see short/long/long_press_threshold_ms fields).

SelectRepress.description: Behavior when pressing the already-active member of a select group. 'resend' = re-send on-message, 'nothing' = no MIDI, 'deselect' = self-toggle off (CC only; PC reserved for #47).

OffMode.description: LED behavior when button is off. 'dim' = reduced brightness, 'off' = extinguished.

MessageType.description: MIDI/HID message type, plus page-switch triggers: 'page_inc'/'page_dec' wrap-advance/retreat the active page by page_step; 'page_jump' clamps to absolute page index.

HidAction.description: 'send' = press+release, 'press' = hold key, 'release' = release key(s), 'delay' = pause execution.

HidModifier.description: Modifier key held during the HID action. 'option' is macOS Alt; 'windows' is the Windows/Meta key.

MidiChannel.description: MIDI channel. Stored as 0-15, displayed as 1-16 in UI.

CycleEntryColor.description: Color for a keytimes cycle entry. 'off' explicitly means LED dark; missing ('(inherit)' in the editor) means no override — the LED falls back to the button-level 'color' field for this entry.

KeytimesMessage.description: One MIDI/HID message fired from a keytimes-mode cycle entry's down or up slot. Discriminated by 'type'.

page_step.description: Number of pages to advance (page_inc) or retreat (page_dec). Wraps at the ends.

page.description: Absolute target page index (0-based). Clamped to a valid page.

key.description: HID key name (see hid_key field on ButtonConfig for valid values).

KeytimesEntry.description: One entry in a keytimes-mode cycle (short or long). Optional down/up message arrays plus color/dim/label per entry.

down.description: Messages fired when this entry's down event triggers (short_down for short cycle, long_down for long cycle). Strict array; single-element today, multi-element supported when #47 lands.

up.description: Messages fired when this entry's up event triggers (short_up for short cycle, long_up for long cycle). Strict array; see down.

color.description: Color for this entry. Missing ('(inherit)' in the editor) means no override — the LED falls back to the button-level 'color' field for this entry. 'off' explicitly forces LED dark (kill-switch when on short layer).

dim.description: When true, the resolved color is rendered at reduced brightness (15% of full via dim_color()).

label.description: Optional display label override for this cycle position. Missing or empty inherits the button-level label.

StateOverride.description: Per-state overrides applied when cycling through keytimes. All fields optional — only specified fields override the base button config.

hid_key.description: Key name override for this keytime state.

label.description: Display label. Max 6 chars, alphanumeric + space + hyphen.

type.description: MIDI message type. Determines which fields apply. Default: 'cc'.

mode.description: Button behavior. 'toggle' = latching LED on/off, 'momentary' = LED on while held, 'flash' = brief LED flash on press (PC types only, default for PC types), 'select' = radio-group exclusivity (PC and CC only, requires select_group). Default for CC/Note/HID: 'toggle'.

select_group.description: Radio-group identifier. Required when mode='select'. Pressing a select-mode button activates it and deactivates all sibling buttons sharing the same select_group. PC and CC types only.

select_repress.description: Behavior when re-pressing the already-active select-group member. Default: 'resend'.

off_mode.description: LED behavior when button is off. Default: 'dim'.

channel.description: Per-button MIDI channel override. Inherits global_channel if omitted.

cc.description: CC number. Used when type='cc'. Default: 20 + button index.

cc_on.description: CC value sent when button is pressed (ON). Default: 127.

cc_off.description: CC value sent when button is released (OFF). Default: 0.

note.description: MIDI note number. Used when type='note'. Default: 60 (Middle C).

velocity_on.description: Note velocity when pressed. Used when type='note'. Default: 127.

velocity_off.description: Note velocity when released (Note Off). Used when type='note'. Default: 0.

program.description: Program number. Used when type='pc'. Default: 0.

pc_step.description: Step size for program change increment/decrement. Used when type='pc_inc' or 'pc_dec'.

page_step.description: Number of pages to advance/retreat. Used when type='page_inc' or 'page_dec'. Wraps at the ends.

page.description: Absolute target page index (0-based). Used when type='page_jump'. Clamped to a valid page.

flash_ms.description: LED flash duration in milliseconds. Used when type is PC and mode is 'flash'.

keytimes.description: DEPRECATED on toggle/momentary/flash/select modes (firmware accepts with a deprecation warning at boot; will be removed in v3.0). Forbidden on mode='keytimes' — use short[]/long[] arrays instead.

states.description: DEPRECATED on toggle/momentary/flash/select modes (firmware accepts with a deprecation warning at boot; will be removed in v3.0). Forbidden on mode='keytimes' — use short[]/long[] arrays instead.

short.description: Short-press cycle entries. Only valid when mode='keytimes'. Each entry can fire messages on down (short_down event), up (short_up event), and carries optional color/dim/label.

long.description: Long-press cycle entries. Only valid when mode='keytimes'. Independent counter from short. Each entry can fire messages on down (long_down event, when threshold reached) and up (long_up event, on release after threshold).

long_press_threshold_ms.description: Per-button long-press threshold override in milliseconds. Only meaningful when mode='keytimes'. Falls back to top-level long_press_threshold_ms (default 500).

long_overlay.description: Only meaningful when mode='keytimes'. When true, the long-press color is used instead of the short-press color; short presses still send their messages as expected (a short 'off' step still turns the LED off). Default false: last-press-wins, so the LED color follows whichever timing class fired most recently (matches the label rule, #157).

hid_action.description: HID action to perform. Used when type='hid'. Default: 'send'.

hid_key.description: Key name for HID action. Used when type='hid'. Valid values: A-Z, 0-9, F1-F12, Mouse_L, Mouse_R, Space, Esc, Caps, Right, Left, Up, Down, End, Del, PageUp, PageDown, Enter, Pause, Table, BackSpace, Home, Ins, PrintS, all (for release-all).

hid_modifier.description: Optional modifier key held during HID action. Used when type='hid' and hid_action='send' or 'press'.

hid_delay_ms.description: Delay duration in milliseconds. Used when type='hid' and hid_action='delay'.

channel.description: Per-push MIDI channel override. Inherits encoder channel or global_channel if omitted.

cc_on.description: CC value when button ON. Default: 127.

cc_off.description: CC value when button OFF. Default: 0.

max.description: Maximum encoder value. Must be >= min.

initial.description: Starting position. Must be between min and max.

steps.description: Number of discrete steps. null = continuous rotation.

channel.description: Per-encoder MIDI channel override. Inherits global_channel if omitted.

cc.description: CC number sent on pedal movement.

max.description: Maximum output value. Must be >= min.

threshold.description: Deadzone threshold. Only report value changes >= this amount.

channel.description: Per-pedal MIDI channel override. Inherits global_channel if omitted.

PageControlJump.description: Jump slot: incoming CC value is the absolute target page index (0-based), clamped to range.

cc.description: CC number that triggers a jump. Incoming value is the 0-based target page index.

PageControlStep.description: Inc/dec slot: fires only when the incoming value equals 'value' (a trigger gate, not a page number); moves the active page by page_step and wraps.

cc.description: CC number that triggers this step.

value.description: Trigger gate: fires only when the incoming CC value equals this. Default 127.

page_step.description: Number of pages to advance/retreat. Wraps at the ends.

PageControl.description: MIDI-IN CC page control (device-level). Checked jump -> inc -> dec, first match wins. A matching CC short-circuits button-CC processing (MIDI THRU still forwards it). channel=null (default) means any channel.

channel.description: MIDI channel filter shared by all 3 slots. null = any channel; int = that channel only.

jump.description: Absolute page jump slot. Omitted = disabled.
